q1_issues.issue: A lowercase common noun plus its of-phrase is fused into caretaker_of_breakheart_hill with an invented genus link, but the instruction set licenses fusion only for modifier+head-noun compounds and routes a possessive of-phrase to (Possession <caretaker> breakheart_hill).
"Breakheart Hill" — the only capitalized run here, hence the name — gets no symbol and no (Name breakheart_hill "Breakheart Hill") fact, leaving a proper noun in the text unrepresented.
The capacity adjunct becomes an untensed top-level (Member henry_cole caretaker_of_breakheart_hill), asserting as a standing fact an office the past-tense succession says he handed over.
The "as caretaker of Breakheart Hill" phrase is never linked to the succeed event by any role or oblique — the adjunct is dropped from the event structure.

q2_gaps: capacity / predicative "as NP" adjunct on a verb ("was succeeded as caretaker of X") — no role, oblique or operator is defined for it
an office / position NP headed by a common noun with an of-phrase naming a place — whether the office is a class the holders are Members of, or a witness linked to the place by Possession
